text: Yes. I want them to be their own prop files. Please. There are other agents i just stopped because i saw them all dumping into one file im pretty damn sure and that is the last thing we want to do. i do not want that. that is going to be impossible to scale. they all need to be like their own individual prop like i downloaded it and added it type of gig
resolution: Extracted all ~15 props whose box/cylinder/sphere geometry was written inline inside resolve.ts (trafficCone, barrier, trashCan, planter, bed, cupboard, mirror, sink, oven, fridge, computer, telephonePole, basketballHoop, and the bush blob builder) into their own per-prop recipe files in compile/propRecipes/, matching the existing bench/chair/tree/rock one-file-per-prop pattern. resolve.ts is now a pure dispatch carrying ZERO geometry — a new prop is a new file + one import + one case, like dropping in a download. Geometry is byte-identical (recipe parts lower 1:1 through lowerRecipePart, recipeColor hex equals the old 0xXX/255 arrays via hx(), part ids dropped on lowering); bundle-checked clean.
